ccr_effects.MOVE: X unaffected, N = (result < 0), Z = (result == 0), V = 0, C = 0
ccr_effects.MOVEQ: X unaffected, N = (result < 0), Z = (result == 0), V = 0, C = 0

instruction_families.memory_accesses: Read source if memory mode; write destination if memory mode (big-endian 8/16/32-bit)
instruction_families.pc_behavior: Sequential advance by instruction word length
instruction_families.cycle_model: Fixed base cycles (4..16 depending on addressing modes) multiplied by 7 for master clock (28..112 cycles)

instruction_families.ccr_effects: X = C, N = (result < 0), Z = (result == 0), V = signed overflow, C = carry/borrow; ADDA/SUBA leave CCR unchanged
instruction_families.memory_accesses: Read memory if source mode 5; write memory if destination mode 5

instruction_families.ccr_effects: X unaffected, N = (dest - src < 0), Z = (dest == src), V = signed overflow, C = (dest < src unsigned); TST sets V=0, C=0
instruction_families.memory_accesses: Read memory if source is d16(An) or (An); destination not written

ccr_effects.ANDI_ORI_EORI_OR_NOT: X unaffected, N = MSB, Z = (res == 0), V = 0, C = 0
ccr_effects.CLR: X unaffected, N = 0, Z = 1, V = 0, C = 0
ccr_effects.NEG: X = C, N = MSB, Z = (res == 0), V = (src == 0x8000), C = (src != 0)

instruction_families.ccr_effects: Z = ((target_bit) == 0); N, V, C, X unaffected
instruction_families.memory_accesses: Read byte from d16(An) for BTST; read-modify-write byte for BSET/BCLR
instruction_families.cycle_model: 12 CPU cycles for memory destination (84 master cycles); 8..12 CPU cycles for register

ccr_effects.LSL_LSR: X = C, N = MSB, Z = (res == 0), V = 0, C = last bit shifted out
ccr_effects.ASR: X = C, N = MSB, Z = (res == 0), V = 0, C = last bit shifted out (sign replicated)
ccr_effects.ROL: X unaffected, N = MSB, Z = (res == 0), V = 0, C = last bit shifted out

instruction_families.cycle_model: Immediate: 6 + 2 * shift CPU cycles = 42 + shift * 14 master cycles; Register: 6 CPU cycles + shift * 14 master cycles with skip_bus_refresh
instruction_families.bus_refresh_effects: Register shift skips DRAM refresh cycle stall to match Musashi hardware simulation order

instruction_families.ccr_effects: None (branches evaluate CCR but do not modify it)
instruction_families.memory_accesses: RTS reads 4 bytes from stack (SP)+ and advances SP by +4
instruction_families.pc_behavior: Branches transfer control to target PC on condition true; fallthrough on false; RTS pops return PC
instruction_families.cycle_model: BRA taken: 10 cycles (70 master); Bcc taken: 10 cycles, not taken: 8 cycles; DBRA loop: 10 cycles, expired: 14 cycles; RTS: 16 cycles (112 master)
unsupported_cases: BSR child function call inside cluster (requires leaf or inlined function)

ccr_effects.SWAP: X unaffected, N = MSB(31), Z = (res == 0), V = 0, C = 0

instruction_families.memory_accesses: None (effective address computed into An; 32-bit register swap)
instruction_families.cycle_model: LEA: 8..12 CPU cycles (56..84 master); SWAP: 4 CPU cycles (28 master)
